verdict.rationale: The Team API documents managing users, locations, and departments. Brex also documents spend-side controls: budgets with auto-enforced limits, per-transaction card limits, and procurement approval flows. None of the evidence describes defining granular user roles or access permissions, so the story is only glancingly supported through org structure and spend controls. Missing for 10: documented role/permission definitions, role scoping by location or department, admin vs. member access controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
